subject: How to read/retain selected page length and column visibility in Shiny DT?

messages.author: d7b1954904ee6e14
messages.subject: How to read/retain selected page length and column visibility in Shiny DT?
parts:
I am quite new to the application, so forgive me if it is obvious. I have a datatable that can be recalculated based on a map center. It works fine. However I would like to read and retain (preserve) certain setting: namely page length and columns visibility. At the moment if a user changes to 10 entries per page and moves the map, it re-renders it with default page length and column vis (using colvis in buttons). I thought i could store it in some variable and retrieve it when re-rendering the table, but not sure how to read from inside the options
Any ideas?

Slav

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: How to read/retain selected page length and column visibility in Shiny DT?
parts:
This is related to a feature that has not been implemented yet (update
data source without recreating the whole table):
https://github.com/rstudio/DT/issues/208 In other words, it is not
straightforward to achieve what you want for now, but it may be
possible in the future.

Regards,
Yihui
